The second panel has a box tightly around one sailboat (the second boat from the left), which is a valid ship. The first panel has no boxes. Since the differing box is good, the panel with it is better.

The instruction is "Insert Image to attach" — the "附着" (Attach) button is in the second close-up (image 3), marked at the attach icon.

{"choice": "SECOND"}

The instruction is to click the "Attach" (附着) button in the Reference panel. The first image shows the circle on the attach icon, which matches.

{"choice": "FIRST"}

The instruction "search filter" — probably the search button in Files window toolbar or the filter... Neither marked point is on a search icon (first is on dark background, second is at the corner of the small Files window).

{"choice": "NEITHER"}

Neither marked point is on a search filter control. The first is at the corner of the small Files window and the second is on empty space between windows. The search filter would be a search icon in a toolbar, such as in the Files window header (the magnifier near the top of the large Files window), and neither point lands there.

{"choice": "NEITHER"}

In the Qualifier icons, the order is: picker, picker+, picker−... Actually the sequence: eyedropper, eyedropper add (+), eyedropper subtract (−)... Looking at image 3: icons at 290 (picker), 318 (picker −), 347 (picker +), 377 (feather −), 405 (feather +), 434 (invert). Feather add is at 405 in image 3, where the highlighted icon is. In image 2: icons at 229, 258, 288, 316 (feather −), 345 (feather +), 373. The red circle in image 2 is at 345, which is the feather add.

In image 3, the circle is at 347, which is picker +.

FIRST is correct.

{"choice": "FIRST"}

The only difference is the green box in the first panel, located at the top left over what appears to be sidewalk/ground with no vehicle. That box is bad, so the panel without it is better.

{"choice": "SECOND"}

The differing box in the second panel covers a single boat in the marina, tightly aligned with one vessel, so it's a good box. The second panel is better.

{"choice": "SECOND"}

The differing box in SECOND is on the sidewalk area near top-left, covering what looks like background/pavement rather than a vehicle. So it's a bad box; FIRST is better.

{"choice": "FIRST"}

The FIRST panel has a green box around a boat in the marina, which looks like a good tight box on a single vessel. The SECOND panel has no visible box. Since the differing box covers a single ship, the panel with it is better.

{"choice": "FIRST"}

The qualifier icons in order: picker, picker-add (+), picker-subtract (−), softness-minus (feather −), softness-plus (feather +), invert/denoise.

In the first panel, the icons: picker, picker -, [circle at third], feather -, feather +, other. The marked point at the third icon is the sub picker (or add). In the second panel, the marked point is at the feather with "+" (5th icon). Feather add = the pen/feather with plus.

In image 2, the icons: 1 picker, 2 picker minus (the "−" visible), 3 marked (picker plus), 4 feather minus (has "−"), 5 feather plus (has "+"). So the marked one in image 2 is picker add. In image 3, the marked is at the 5th icon, which is feather plus.

{"choice": "SECOND"}

The differing box in the first panel covers an empty floor area below the shelf label, not a retail product. So it's a bad box; the panel without it is better.

{"choice": "SECOND"}

The differing box in SECOND covers an area of floor and part of a price tag below the shelf, not a retail product. It is a bad box, so the panel without it is better.

{"choice": "FIRST"}

The differing box in the second panel tightly covers one product facing, the Dove boxed set in the middle. It is a good box, so the panel that has it is better.

{"choice": "SECOND"}

The differing box is the green one in the first panel, around the Dove gift set box in the center. It tightly covers exactly one product facing (the boxed set with the "嗨 100ml" label), so it's a good box. The second panel has no boxes.

{"choice": "FIRST"}

The only difference is the green box in the second panel, which covers the Secret label area of the left deodorant. It is placed on the label and lower portion of the first product rather than the full product facing (which would extend higher to include the cap/top). The box spans roughly from y=65 to y=132, covering the label but not the whole product. It's a partial-object box, so it's not tight on a whole product.

Still, it's arguably covering the product body partially. The product facing extends from top (~y=20) to bottom (~y=125). The box covers the label region only, which is part of the object.

Therefore the box is bad (part of an object), so the panel without it is better.

{"choice": "FIRST"}
